name: Solar Wind Silk Pavilion
description: A pavilion of flowing silk ribbons that dance with solar wind, glowing with charged particles.
prompt: An open‑air pavilion composed of countless silk ribbons suspended from a lightweight frame. The ribbons sway as if blown by a solar wind, each strand glowing with tiny charged particles in gold and teal. Bright daytime sky, high detail, 8k.
caption: Silk that rides the solar breeze. ☀️🌬️
